question: Should stored `update.channel: "extended-stable"` package installs receive read-only startup and 24-hour npm availability hints by default?
rationale: This changes an existing stored-channel runtime contract from skipped startup/background resolution to startup network checks, which is compatibility-sensitive and cannot be settled by tests alone.

options.title: Approve after real proof
options.body: Allow default read-only extended-stable startup hints once the contributor adds redacted real package Gateway proof and normal merge gates pass.

options.title: Keep foreground/status only
options.body: Keep the current merged contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99811 and do not add startup checks for extended-stable.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add the hint path behind a separate user-controlled setting or migration instead of changing stored extended-stable behavior by default.

recommendation.title: Approve after real proof
recommendation.body: Allow default read-only extended-stable startup hints once the contributor adds redacted real package Gateway proof and normal merge gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the update startup contract and default upgrade behavior, and steipete has the clearest history on the startup updater surface.
